description: Successor of mcp-conformance-baseline-followup-v2, whose first draft failed todo lint because its expected text did not declare an unfixed-tree failure. The pinned MCP 2026-07-28 conformance run at revision 81eb1c3 passes the selected scenarios only with four explicit server-stateless baseline entries: two required checks for the diagnostic test_missing_capability fixture and two SHOULD warnings for promptsListChanged and toolsListChanged notifications. The run log classifies the first pair as a fixture/tool-surface gap and the second pair as a static-registry behavior, but this compatibility debt is not yet independently tracked. Revalidate the classification against the current upstream suite and BenchBox contract; do not let the baseline hide a real protocol defect or silently broaden it when upstream checks change.
